name: coding-agent-skills-hooks
description: The hooks of the coding-agent-skills collection, each run in every session: session-build-limits.sh gives a session a fixed share of the machine for builds and tests, scratchpad-guard.sh keeps loose program files out of temporary directories and gives each subagent that rule, plans-check-hook.sh checks the plan graph after a plan node is written, memory-write-reminder.sh points a memory write at the layer that owns the rule, browser-check-hook.sh has a session check which browser it drives before acting on a page, and reply-lint-hook.sh lints a kanban final response.
